extraction.notes: No summer 2027 information or explicitly dated summer 2026 details were found. The official summer camp page has undated hours, prices, lunch information, and dates ('Camp starts the week of June 10th and runs until August 29th.'); these were not assigned to 2026 or 2027. Direct opens returned no readable content, so official search-index text was used. The registration page has no dated opening announcement. Contact instructions on the camp page request an email with the child's name, age, requested dates, and a contact number. Half-day and full-day options belong to the same program.
